anime.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
anime.synopsis: The elf mage Frieren outlives the heroes she once travelled with, and sets out to understand the human lives that passed her by in a blink.

anime.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
anime.synopsis: Two brothers pay a terrible price for a forbidden transmutation, and chase the Philosopher’s Stone across a country built on alchemy and war.

anime.title: Monster
